environment: Ubuntu 24.04.4 X11, current running production instance
scenario: 1 active OpenSSH child process; terminal contents and connection details not inspected
measurement_notes: PSS is proportional physical-memory attribution including shared pages. RSS aggregate uses /proc/stat and is approximate, while per-process detail uses smaps_rollup; shared pages are counted repeatedly in RSS. GPU device memory is not included. Single current-use scenario, not a multi-session stress test.
